title: Committed test-only key as witness is UNPROVEN (ATTESTATION_UNTRUSTED)
description: The OEPT conformance test-only key signs the attestations (envelopes produced outside the library, which refuses that key) and is wrongly present in the witness trust store. The verifier-side blocklist must still reject it: the key is skipped during verification, so the hinted keyid is trusted-but-unverifiable and the rejection surfaces as SIGNATURE_INVALID.
